text:
lucy: Alert from vault-audit: partner-namespace leases renewing past TTL again. Saw ~45 renew events after expiry. Link: https://internal/alerts/3890123456
omar: Ack. Likely the partner-renewer cron rolled yesterday. I'll pause it: `kubectl scale deploy/partner-renewer -n infra 0`
frank: I'll assemble consumer list and run revokes. Command I'll use: `vault lease revoke -prefix=partner-namespace/lease_389*` throttled to 20/min to avoid outage spikes.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-3890123456. PagerDuty paged sec-oncall.
lucy: Also: enable debug audit on partner namespace and snapshot KMS key metadata. We'll rewrap ciphertexts and rotate key version after revokes. Omar, can you run rewrap?
omar: Yes. I'll create new key version and stream re-encrypts to s3://redwood-encrypted/partner/rewrap/3890123456/
frank: Revokes started; ~30 revoked so far, small consumer 503s observed, throttling. Audit export path: s3://redwood-audit/exports/revokes/3890123456.json
lucy: Applied temporary RBAC removal for serviceAccount:partner-ingest@redwood-prod; terraform PR opened for urgent review.
omar: Rewrap job complete, rotated key version v5 -> v6 and set primary. Deployed rolling restarts to consumers; smoke tests pass.
frank: Revoke+rewrap containment complete. Postmortem scheduled Mon 9am PT. Action items: auto-detect renewals > TTL, auto-revoke prototype, partner onboarding gating.
lucy: I'll draft partner comms and coordinate legal if the exported blob we found is confirmed. Closing thread for now, move notes to postmortem doc.
